beats.say: At home, the router, the TV and the baby camera share one network. If one is weak, all are at risk.
If you get a notification like this, someone is watching your camera without your knowledge.

title.text: Live view from a new device

beats.say: A camera in a child's room films the most private moments. Give it the strongest protection.
Let us look at the settings together: which are safe, and which create a risk?

scenes.prompt: Is this setting safe or a threat?

body.text: On. Devices can open ports by themselves.

cards.explain: This feature lets devices open doors on their own. If you do not need it, turn it off.

body.text: Camera, TV and robot vacuum are here. Phones and laptops stay on the main network.

cards.explain: Correct. Even if a weak device is hacked, it cannot reach your phone or computer.

body.text: User: admin. Password: the default one printed under the box.

cards.explain: The router is the front door of your whole home. Replace the default password with a long passphrase.
Automatic updates close known holes on their own. Keep this setting on.

body.text: Port 554: camera, open to everyone on the internet

cards.explain: This rule opens the camera to the whole internet. Delete it and watch remotely only through the official app.
Modern encryption and a long passphrase keep outsiders off your home network.

scenes.title: A night notification
scenes.intro: It is one in the morning. A baby camera notification arrives. Make the right call at every step.

title.text: Live view from a new device

actions.label: Open notification
actions.feedback: Correct. First see what is happening in your own app.

actions.label: Leave it till morning
actions.feedback: Someone is watching the child's room right now. This cannot wait.

steps.say: Two devices are connected to the camera.

actions.label: Sign out all and change password
actions.feedback: Well done. The stranger's device is out, and the new password keeps it out.

actions.label: Close
actions.feedback: The stranger's device stays connected and keeps watching. Sign out every device right away.

body.text: Our camera was hacked too. This app protects it, download it:

steps.say: In the morning, the parents' group shares some advice.

actions.label: Open link
actions.feedback: An app from an unknown source can take over your phone, not protect your camera. Install apps only from the official store.

actions.label: Do not tap the link
actions.feedback: Right. A link that looks like help can be a new trap.

actions.label: Install
actions.feedback: This app would ask for wide permissions and could steal your data. Do not install it.

actions.label: Cancel
actions.feedback: Good call. A camera is protected by a password, updates and two-step sign-in, not by an extra app.

body.text: Update the camera and turn on two-step sign-in for the account.

actions.label: Update and turn on
actions.feedback: Correct. The update closes the hole, and two-step sign-in makes a stolen password useless.

actions.label: Later
actions.feedback: The camera still runs with the old hole. Update it today.

nodes.text: In the evening, a strange voice comes from the baby camera's speaker. Someone is talking to the child.

choices.label: I unplug the camera
choices.feedback: Correct. First cut the picture and sound, then lock the access.

choices.label: I answer and ask who it is
choices.feedback: Talking only costs time while the camera keeps running. Switch it off first.

choices.label: I must have imagined it
choices.feedback: The stranger can still see and hear. Switch the camera off right away.

nodes.text: The camera is off. What now?

choices.label: I change the password, update, turn on two-step sign-in and report it to the police
choices.feedback: Well done. Access is fully closed, and the police investigate cases like this.

choices.label: I buy a new camera and set the old password
choices.feedback: The old password will open the new camera too. Give every device its own strong password.

question.prompt: You bought a new smart TV. Which steps are needed?

options.label: Connect it to the guest network
options.feedback: Correct. Even if the TV is hacked, it cannot reach your phone or computer.

options.label: Turn on automatic updates
options.feedback: Correct. Updates close known holes on their own.

options.label: Keep the default account password
options.feedback: A default password is known to everyone. Change it right away.

options.label: Allow every microphone and contacts request
options.feedback: A permission you do not need is extra risk. Allow only the features you use.

scenes.explain: A smart device belongs on a separate network, updated and with its own password. Turn off permissions you do not need.

points: Put devices on a separate guest network.
Turn off UPnP and port forwarding.
Strange access? Sign out all devices, change the password.
